title: Monopoles on the edge
summary: Quantum M2-brane instantons are studied in eleven-dimensional Freund-Rubin backgrounds. The construction uses the identification of the Calabi-Yau cone over the Sasaki-Einstein manifold $\mathrm{SE}_7$ with the geometric branch of the abelian moduli space of the dual superconformal field theory. A class of BPS cycles in $\mathrm{SE}_7$ wrapped by M2-branes is identified as links of two-dimensional holomorphic cones whose coordinate rings contain BPS monopole operators.
